description: This Java source file defines the class 'PcChargeServices' which provides services for processing credit card transactions such as authorization, capture, release, and refund through the 'PcChargeApi' interface, specifically for integrating with GoSoftware payment gateway within the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: PcChargeServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods to handle credit card transactions including authorization, capture, release, and refund using the 'PcChargeApi' interface.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization by sending transaction details to the GoSoftware API and processes the response to determine success or failure.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a pre-authorized transaction based on an existing authorization reference number.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a previously authorized transaction if supported by the configured autoBill setting.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a captured payment based on the authorization reference number.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Populates the PCCharge API with credit card data extracted from the context, including name, number, expiration, and billing address.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Creates and configures a 'PcChargeApi' instance with provided properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Constructs properties for connecting to the GoSoftware payment gateway based on configuration files.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats the transaction amount according to configured scale and rounding mode.
